description: This file defines the A2UIHandler class responsible for managing interactions and message handling between an Android app's UI and a web-based A2UI component. It includes functions for URL resolution, readiness checks, message decoding, and message application via JavaScript execution in a web view.

classes.name: A2UIHandler
classes.description: Handles communication and message processing for the Android UI component interfacing with web-based A2UI elements, including URL resolution, readiness checks, message decoding, and applying messages.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is trusted for canvas actions by verifying against known trusted URLs.

methods.name: resolveA2uiHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the host URL for the A2UI component based on available node or operator URLs.

methods.name: ensureA2uiReady
methods.description: Waits asynchronously until the A2UI component is ready by polling its status, with a timeout.

methods.name: decodeA2uiMessages
methods.description: Decodes JSON-formatted messages received from the A2UI component, validating and transforming them into a JSON array string.

methods.name: validateA2uiV0_8
methods.description: Validates that a message conforms to the expected A2UI v0.8 schema, ensuring only certain message types are present.

methods.name: a2uiApplyMessagesJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to apply a set of messages to the A2UI component within a web view.
